intent.purpose: place a specific protein-shaker product into an approved kitchen-counter POV slide
intent.scene_concept: high-angle POV of a meal-prep counter in a home kitchen, as generated in E1, now with the shaker from P1 standing beside the containers
must_stay_true: everything in E1: containers, food, counter, light, noise, angle and framing
the shaker is the exact product in P1: shape, colour, lid and printed branding
change_only: add the P1 shaker standing upright on the counter at frame right, behind the second container, half full of a beige protein shake with foam at the top

subject.description: meal-prep containers and a protein shaker on a kitchen counter
subject.action: none; still life seen from above

environment.setting: home kitchen counter in the evening, as in E1
foreground: four glass meal-prep containers with rice, chicken and broccoli
the inserted shaker at frame right
background: a used spatula on a plate

camera.device: iPhone rear main camera, as in E1
camera.position: held above the counter pointing down at about 60 degrees, as in E1

casts: warm cast from the ceiling light

imperfections: the shaker picks up the same noise and softness as the rest of the frame

texture.surfaces: glass with condensation, matte plastic shaker with a printed label, speckled laminate

physics: the shaker stands on the counter with a contact shadow matching the ceiling light
the shaker is scaled correctly next to the containers (about 20 cm tall)
the shake level is flat and the foam sits on top
geometry.reflections: the shaker's plastic picks up the ceiling light as a soft highlight
geometry.perspective: the shaker follows the same high-angle perspective as the containers

typography.scene_text: the shaker's printed branding exactly as in P1; no other new text

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep P1's real printed branding exactly; keep E1's existing branding unchanged
brands: the shaker brand printed on P1

exclusions: no people, hands or body parts
no misspelled or garbled label text
no studio product-shot lighting or clean seamless background
no change to anything outside the inserted shaker

must_preserve: every existing object, the light, the noise and the framing

may_copy: the shaker's shape, colour, lid and printed branding
must_not_transfer: P1's white product-shot background, studio lighting and shadow
